data.one_liner: Customised Flutter TextFormField to input international phone numbers with country codes.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customized text form field widget specifically designed for international phone number input. It includes a country code selector dialog, input masking, validation support, and customizable UI configurations.
use_when: You need user registration or profile forms that require international phone numbers.
You want built-in country code selection and phone number formatting.
avoid_when: You only require basic standard text fields without phone formatting or country codes.
strengths: Includes customizable dialog and country code configurations.
Supports custom JSON loading for country data.
Provides built-in validation and masking options.
weaknesses: Limited documentation on advanced phone number parsing verification.
Relies on specific third-party dependencies for formatting and flags.

alternatives.name: intl_phone_field
alternatives.why_pick_it: Alternative phone number input field package available in the catalog.
